prior_browser_status_preserved: The original historical manifest remains untouched; this is a supplemental audit layer.
scope: 37 unpublished resources, including one Microsoft Learn previously validated externally.

status_contract.CONTENT_ACCESS_CONFIRMED: Source public URL and relevant content confirmed using live browser-backed page extraction or live PDF extraction. NOT blanket browser-UI / course-completion certification.
status_contract.PARTIAL: Public landing/index/document reached, but an important activity, video, scanned body, or lesson behind authentication was not inspected.
status_contract.BLOCKED_BROWSER: At least two independent browser tools could not load the page; independent non-browser extraction may work.
status_contract.VERIFIED_PREVIOUS_BROWSER: Distinct earlier interactive TinyFish browser session fully confirmed public first-unit content.

release_blockers: ESA 2026 PDF browser: ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED. Do not mistake extractor content for browser availability.
Seven items have targeted follow-up gaps; no false verified status.
The 37 source smoke checks are not a full mobile/accessibility/certificate audit for a release candidate.
QA code changes in PR #38 still require independent code review, release candidate testing on integration branch and explicit owner approval.
